passages.text: “Don’t indulge in sensual pleasure, which is low, crude, ordinary, ignoble, and pointless. And don’t indulge in self-mortification, which is painful, ignoble, and pointless. Avoiding these two extremes, the Realized One understood the middle way of practice, which gives vision and knowledge, and leads to peace, direct knowledge, awakening, and extinguishment.
passages.note: Balance between indulgence and harshness toward oneself

passages.text: Don’t talk behind people’s backs, and don’t speak sharply in their presence. Don’t speak hurriedly.
